## The app

## Done when

- [ ] Repository in this organisation (private).
- [ ] The **latest** code pushed. It doesn't need to be tidy or complete.
- [ ] No secrets committed: passwords, API keys and `.env` files stay out (add a `.gitignore`).
- [ ] No real data committed: no database dumps, uploads or exports.
- [ ] A short `README.md`: what it is, who uses it, where it runs.
- [ ] Ticked off on the inventory.
